metaDescription: Massage & bodywork, functional strength, women’s wellness, integrated nutrition and life coaching in Brighton and Howell, MI: human performance for real life.

hero.headline: More capacity for what matters.
hero.body: Integrated care and coaching to help you build strength, resilience and the capacity to live fully.

coreIdea.headline: Human performance for real life.
coreIdea.body: At TAB, human performance isn’t maximum output. It’s how well you function, adapt, recover, connect and act in the life you actually have. Strength, recovery, nourishment, stress and the choices you make each day all affect one another, so TAB brings five areas of support into one integrated approach.

pillars.headline: Five ways to build capacity.
pillars.closing: Start with the service that fits what you need today. You can use one service or several; we connect them only when that genuinely helps your goals.

method.headline: Start where you are. Transform. Adapt. Balance.
method.body: Transform what limits you. Adapt to what life asks. Balance what sustains you.

points.title: We integrate.
points.body: We connect the pieces instead of treating you as separate problems.

points.title: We build ownership.
points.body: The goal is agency and self-trust, not dependence on us.

guided.headline: You don’t need to know exactly where to start.
guided.body: Tell us what you’re experiencing, what you want to change, or what you hope to be able to do. We’ll help you find the right starting point.

trust.headline: Real people. Personal progress.
trust.body: TAB has worked with clients in Brighton and Howell since 2008. The name is new; the personal, integrated way we work is not.

resources.headline: Support that continues between sessions.
resources.body: Guides and practical resources to help you understand, prepare, practice and keep building capacity.

closing.headline: Start where you are.
closing.body: Wherever you’re starting, we begin by listening.
